name: 11757 · Lindenhurst, NY
findings: ZIP 11757 (Lindenhurst) has 87 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11757 (Lindenhurst) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11757 (Lindenhurst) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
